units: <cite ref="Yoma 39b:8">Yoma 39ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <he>בית יער</he>, <cite ref="I Kings 10:21">I Kings X, 21</cite> as designating the Temple) <he>מה היער מלבלב וכ׳</he> as the forest produces sprouts, so does the Temple. Ib. 81ᵇ (expl. <he>לולבי גפנים</he>) <he>כל שלִבְלְבוּ מר״ה וכ׳</he> such as sprouted forth between New Year and the Day of Atonement; a. e.
